title: 🤔 क्या मिष्टी बिना बाल्टी अपनी कविता का ताल पूरा कर पाएगी? #hindikids #kavita
title_alts: 😅 मिष्टी ने छत पर बाल्टी थपथपाई, पर छोटा भाई वही बाल्टी माँगने आया... #hindikids #kavita
😮 मिष्टी की बाल्टी और बीच में रुकी कविता... छत पर ताल अब कौन देगा? #hindikids #kavita
refrain: एक थाप, दो थाप, ताल पूरा!
description_hook: छत पर कविता का ताल एक ही बाल्टी से चल रहा था। फिर वही बाल्टी छोटे भाई को चाहिए थी।

characters.name: मिष्टी
characters.description: six years old, two short braids with red bands, yellow kurta and blue shorts, a small red bindi

scenes.narration: छत पर मिष्टी को ताल देना था, वरना कविता रुक जाती। बाल्टी ही ढोल थी।
scenes.caption: Mishti had to keep the beat, or the poem stopped. The bucket was the drum.
scenes.image_brief: Mishti, a six-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red bands, a yellow kurta and blue shorts, kneels on a flat rooftop with both palms resting on an upside-down steel bucket. Three children sit cross-legged in front of her holding open notebooks. Her four-year-old brother in a green vest and grey shorts stands near the parapet. Late afternoon sunlight, a washing line and two tulsi pots behind them, cheerful mood.

scenes.narration: मिष्टी ने बाल्टी थपथपाई। धीमी सी आवाज़ आई। गिनती एक, दो, तीन। तुम भी थपथपाओ!
scenes.caption: Mishti tapped the bucket. A soft sound came. One, two, three. Tap along too!
scenes.image_brief: Mishti, a six-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red bands, a yellow kurta and blue shorts, slaps the upside-down steel bucket with flat palms on the rooftop, her mouth open as she counts. The three seated children lean forward and one holds up three fingers. Her four-year-old brother in a green vest and grey shorts crouches beside the bucket. Warm low sunlight, long shadows across the roof.

scenes.narration: एक थाप, दो थाप, ताल पूरा!
scenes.caption: One tap, two taps, the beat is whole!
scenes.image_brief: Mishti, a six-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red bands, a yellow kurta and blue shorts, chants with her chin lifted and one palm raised above the steel bucket on the rooftop. The three children clap in time. Her four-year-old brother in a green vest and grey shorts copies her raised hand. Golden evening light across the rooftop.

scenes.narration: छोटा भाई आया और बाल्टी माँगी। खींचातानी में बाल्टी छत के पार लुढ़की। कविता बीच में रुकी।
scenes.caption: Her little brother wanted the bucket. It rolled across the roof. The poem stopped.
scenes.image_brief: On the rooftop Mishti, a six-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red bands, a yellow kurta and blue shorts, and her four-year-old brother in a green vest and grey shorts both reach after the steel bucket, which is rolling on its side toward the far corner of the roof. The three children sit with their notebooks closed, silent. Flat grey light, a little dust in the air.

scenes.narration: मिष्टी ने बाल्टी भाई को दी। टिफ़िन की थाली, दो चम्मच उठाए। बोली, “एक थाप, दो थाप, ताल पूरा!”
scenes.caption: Mishti gave her brother the bucket and picked up her tiffin plate and two spoons.
scenes.image_brief: Mishti, a six-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red bands, a yellow kurta and blue shorts, holds a round steel tiffin plate in one hand and two spoons in the other on the rooftop. Her four-year-old brother in a green vest and grey shorts hugs the steel bucket, delighted. The three children look up from their notebooks. Warm evening light, long shadows.

scenes.narration: एक थाप, दो थाप, ताल पूरा!
scenes.caption: One tap, two taps, the beat is whole!
scenes.image_brief: Mishti, a six-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red bands, a yellow kurta and blue shorts, strikes the steel plate with two spoons on the rooftop, mouth open in a chant, while her four-year-old brother in a green vest and grey shorts thumps the upturned bucket beside her. The three children clap along. Bright warm evening sunlight.

scenes.narration: अब भाई बाल्टी पर, मिष्टी थाली पर। धीरे से गुनगुनाओ, तुम भी।
scenes.caption: Now brother on the bucket, Mishti on the plate. Hum along, softly.
scenes.image_brief: Mishti, a six-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red bands, a yellow kurta and blue shorts, taps the steel plate softly with one spoon while her four-year-old brother in a green vest and grey shorts pats the upturned bucket beside her on the rooftop. The three children hum with their eyes half closed. Dusk light, a pink sky behind the water tank.

scenes.narration: मिष्टी हँस पड़ी। ताल पहले से बड़ा लगा। एक थाप, दो थाप, ताल पूरा!
scenes.caption: Mishti laughed. The beat sounded bigger than before. One tap, two taps, whole!
scenes.image_brief: Mishti, a six-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red bands, a yellow kurta and blue shorts, laughs with her head tilted back and the spoons raised over the steel plate on the rooftop, while her four-year-old brother in a green vest and grey shorts drums the bucket beside her. The three children sing with their hands up. Last orange sunlight, happy mood.

title: 😳 पीहू ने बारह लाइनें जोड़ीं, पर आठवीं लाइन पर शब्द उलझ गए... #kids #kahani
title_alts: 🤔 क्या पीहू की सबसे लंबी कविता चार बच्चों की ताली पा सकेगी? #kids #kahani
😊 पीहू की लंबी पट्टी और अटकी हुई आठवीं लाइन... अब कमरे में क्या होगा? #kids #kahani
refrain: एक थपकी, एक लाइन, फिर आगे!
description_hook: पीहू चाहती थी कि उसकी कविता सबसे लंबी हो। बारह लाइनें लिखना आसान था, याद रखना नहीं।

characters.name: पीहू
characters.description: six years old, short bob with a red hairclip, orange frock, a smudge of pencil on one cheek

scenes.narration: पीहू की कविता सबसे लंबी होनी थी, वरना ताली नहीं मिलती। कमरे में चार बच्चे बैठे।
scenes.caption: Peehu's poem had to be the longest, or no one clapped. Four children sat down.
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, stands in a small room holding a long strip of paper covered in handwritten lines. Four children sit cross-legged on a mat in front of her with their hands in their laps. Soft daylight through a window, a ceiling fan and a cot behind them, eager mood.

scenes.narration: पीहू ने पट्टी पर बारह लाइनें लिखीं। आठवीं पर शब्द उलझे। तुम भी गिनो, आठ या नौ?
scenes.caption: Peehu had written twelve lines. The eighth tangled. Count with her: eight or nine?
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, reads from the long paper strip held at arm's length in the small room, her lips pursed in the middle of a word. Two of the four seated children hold up fingers to count, the other two fidget with the mat. Daylight from the window, the fan turning above.

scenes.narration: एक थपकी, एक लाइन, फिर आगे!
scenes.caption: One tap, one line, then on we go!
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, taps her own knee with two fingers while chanting, the long paper strip tucked under one arm, standing in the small room. The four children watch her tapping hand. Bright daylight from the window.

scenes.narration: दो बच्चे उठकर बाहर चल दिए। पीहू फिर उसी लाइन पर अटकी।
scenes.caption: Two children got up and walked outside. Peehu stuck on the same line again.
scenes.image_brief: In the small room two children walk out through the doorway with their backs turned, while Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, stands with the long paper strip drooping from one hand and her mouth half open. The two children still on the mat look at the floor. Flat daylight, the window pale.

scenes.narration: पीहू ने पट्टी चार टुकड़ों में फाड़ी। हर बच्चे को एक टुकड़ा। बोली, “एक थपकी, एक लाइन, फिर आगे!”
scenes.caption: Peehu tore the strip into four pieces and handed one to each child.
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, holds four short torn pieces of the paper strip fanned out in one hand in the small room and passes one to each of the two children on the mat. Two empty places on the mat beside them. Daylight from the window, lively mood.

scenes.narration: एक थपकी, एक लाइन, फिर आगे!
scenes.caption: One tap, one line, then on we go!
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, taps her knee in time in the small room while the two children hold their torn paper pieces and tap their knees the same way. Daylight from the window, warm mood.

scenes.narration: बाहर गए बच्चे लौट आए। चारों ने बारी बारी लाइन कही। तुम भी जोड़ो!
scenes.caption: The two who left came back. All four said a line in turn. Add yours too!
scenes.image_brief: Four children sit in a circle on the mat in the small room, each holding a short torn paper piece, one of them speaking with a hand raised while the others tap their knees. Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, kneels in the circle listening. Soft late daylight from the window, calm mood.

scenes.narration: पीहू को छोटी कविता बड़ी लगी। एक थपकी, एक लाइन, फिर आगे!
scenes.caption: Peehu's short poem felt bigger than the long one. One tap, one line, then on!
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, sits back on her heels in the small room with shining eyes and her torn paper piece pressed to her chest, the four children around her tapping their knees together. Warm late daylight from the window, contented mood.

title: 😯 क्या छुटकी तीनों आलूबुखारे एक ही चक्कर में घर तक ले जाएगी? #hindikids #kahani
title_alts: 😅 छुटकी ने पत्ते का थैला बनाया, पर दो कदम पर वह फट गया... #hindikids #kahani
😮 छुटकी के आलूबुखारे और फटा हुआ पत्ता... ढलान पर कौवा कितना पास? #hindikids #kahani
description_hook: छुटकी के तीन आलूबुखारे ढलान पर पड़े थे और कौवे ऊपर घूम रहे थे। एक ही चक्कर में सब घर जाने थे।

characters.name: छुटकी
characters.description: small young squirrel, reddish-brown fur, three cream stripes down her back, one torn left ear

scenes.narration: तीन आलूबुखारे छुटकी के, पर कौवे ऊपर मंडरा रहे थे। एक चक्कर में घर पहुँचाना था।
scenes.caption: Three plums were Chhutki's, but crows circled above. One trip to get them home.
scenes.image_brief: Chhutki, a small young squirrel with reddish-brown fur, three cream stripes down her back and a torn left ear, stands over three round purple plums lying on a grassy slope under a plum tree. Two crows circle in the sky above her. Her hollow in the tree trunk is visible higher up the slope. Bright mid-morning light, dew on the grass, alert mood.

scenes.narration: छुटकी ने बड़े पत्ते का थैला बनाया। तीनों फल रखे। दो कदम पर पत्ता फटा, फल ढलान से लुढ़के।
scenes.caption: Chhutki made a bag from a big leaf. Two steps on it tore; the plums rolled off.
scenes.image_brief: Chhutki, a small young squirrel with reddish-brown fur, three cream stripes down her back and a torn left ear, holds the split edges of a big green leaf on the grassy slope while all three purple plums tumble out of it and roll downhill away from her. The two crows are lower in the sky now. Bright morning light, grass bent where the plums rolled.

scenes.narration: तीन आलूबुखारे, एक ही चक्कर!
scenes.caption: Three plums, one single trip!
scenes.image_brief: Chhutki, a small young squirrel with reddish-brown fur, three cream stripes down her back and a torn left ear, sits up on her hind legs on the grassy slope with the three purple plums gathered against her chest, mouth open in a chant. The plum tree and her tree hollow behind her. Bright morning light, determined mood.

scenes.narration: कौवा दो कदम दूर उतरा। छुटकी ने पतली टहनी तीनों डंठलों में पिरो दी। बोली, “तीन आलूबुखारे, एक ही चक्कर!” तुम भी बोलो!
scenes.caption: A crow landed two steps away. Chhutki threaded a thin twig through the three stems.
scenes.image_brief: Chhutki, a small young squirrel with reddish-brown fur, three cream stripes down her back and a torn left ear, pushes a thin bare twig through the stems of three purple plums on the grassy slope so they hang in a row like beads, while a large black crow stands two steps away on the grass with its head tilted. Bright morning light, tense and busy mood.

scenes.narration: तीन आलूबुखारे, एक ही चक्कर!
scenes.caption: Three plums, one single trip!
scenes.image_brief: Chhutki, a small young squirrel with reddish-brown fur, three cream stripes down her back and a torn left ear, holds up the twig with three purple plums threaded on it above her head on the grassy slope, mouth open in a chant, the crow hopping backwards. Bright morning light, triumphant mood.

scenes.narration: छुटकी टहनी कंधे पर रखकर चली। तीन फल साथ साथ हिले। धीरे से गाओ, तुम भी।
scenes.caption: Chhutki walked with the twig on her shoulder. Three plums swayed. Sing it softly too.
scenes.image_brief: Chhutki, a small young squirrel with reddish-brown fur, three cream stripes down her back and a torn left ear, walks uphill along the grassy slope with the twig balanced across one shoulder and the three purple plums swaying behind her. The crow watches from a fence post. Softer late morning light, calm mood.

scenes.narration: छुटकी को रास्ता छोटा लगा। तीन आलूबुखारे, एक ही चक्कर!
scenes.caption: The way home felt short to Chhutki. Three plums, one single trip!
scenes.image_brief: Chhutki, a small young squirrel with reddish-brown fur, three cream stripes down her back and a torn left ear, stands at the round opening of her tree hollow on the slope with the twig of three purple plums held across both front paws, her torn ear twitching. Warm light through the plum leaves, contented mood.

title: 😬 सोहम ने रिबन वाली घंटी हिलाई, पर छोटी बहन ने उसे खींच लिया... #kids #rhyme
title_alts: 🤔 क्या सोहम की साइकिल गमले से टकराने के बाद दुकान तक पहुँचेगी? #kids #rhyme
💛 सोहम की घंटी और छोटी बहन की ज़िद... गमला चटका, अब खेल का क्या? #kids #rhyme
refrain: टन टन, दो घंटी, रास्ता खाली!
description_hook: सोहम का खेल एक ही था, हर मोड़ पर घंटी। पीछे बैठी छोटी बहन को वही घंटी चाहिए थी।

characters.name: सोहम
characters.description: seven years old, short spiky hair, blue striped t-shirt, brown sandals, a scab on one knee

scenes.narration: घंटी बजाते सोहम को दुकान तक जाना था, वरना खेल ख़त्म। छोटी बहन पीछे बैठी थी।
scenes.caption: Sohum had to reach the shop ringing the bell, or the game was over.
scenes.image_brief: Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, sits on a small bicycle at the mouth of a narrow lane with a brass bell tied to the handlebar with a red ribbon. His four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails sits on the carrier behind him holding his shirt. Morning light between low houses, a shop shutter far down the lane, eager mood.

scenes.narration: सोहम ने रिबन वाली घंटी हिलाई। तुम भी बोलो, टन टन! बहन ने भी घंटी माँगी।
scenes.caption: Sohum shook the ribboned bell. Say it too: ting ting! His sister wanted it as well.
scenes.image_brief: Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, rides slowly down the narrow lane shaking the brass bell on its red ribbon with one hand, mouth open in a chant, while his four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails reaches forward over his shoulder towards the bell. Morning light, house walls close on both sides.

scenes.narration: टन टन, दो घंटी, रास्ता खाली!
scenes.caption: Ting ting, two bells, the road is clear!
scenes.image_brief: Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, rings the brass bell twice with his thumb in the narrow lane, chin up and mouth open in a chant, his four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails laughing behind him. Two hens step aside ahead of the wheel. Clear morning light.

scenes.narration: बहन ने घंटी खींची, हैंडल घूमा। साइकिल गमले से टकराई। गमला चटका, रिबन खुला।
scenes.caption: His sister pulled the bell and the handlebar turned. The cycle hit a flower pot.
scenes.image_brief: In the narrow lane the small bicycle has stopped against a clay flower pot beside a doorstep, a crack running down the pot, the red ribbon hanging loose from the handlebar. Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, holds the tilted bicycle upright with both feet on the ground while his four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails clutches the brass bell. Flat morning light, dust in the air.

scenes.narration: सोहम ने घंटी बहन की मुट्ठी में रखी। बोला, “घंटी तुम्हारी, चलाना मेरा। टन टन, दो घंटी, रास्ता खाली!”
scenes.caption: Sohum put the bell in his sister's fist: yours to ring, mine to pedal.
scenes.image_brief: Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, closes his four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails's small fist around the brass bell in the narrow lane, both of them beside the cracked clay pot, the bicycle leaning on his hip. Morning light, a kind older woman watching from a doorway.

scenes.narration: टन टन, दो घंटी, रास्ता खाली!
scenes.caption: Ting ting, two bells, the road is clear!
scenes.image_brief: His four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails holds the brass bell high and rings it, mouth open in a chant, sitting on the carrier of the small bicycle while Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, pedals slowly down the narrow lane. Bright morning light between the houses.

scenes.narration: साइकिल फिर धीरे चली। हर मोड़ पर बहन की घंटी बजी।
scenes.caption: The cycle rolled on slowly. At every turn his sister's bell rang.
scenes.image_brief: Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, pedals the small bicycle around a corner of the narrow lane with both hands on the handlebar, his four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails ringing the brass bell behind him. Warm light on one wall, shade on the other, easy mood.

scenes.narration: दुकान पास आ गई। साथ में गिनो, एक दो!
scenes.caption: The shop came close. Count along with them: one, two!
scenes.image_brief: Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, and his four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails on the small bicycle a few steps from the shop shutter at the end of the narrow lane, the shopkeeper stacking biscuit tins outside. The brass bell is in the little girl's hand. Warm morning light, happy mood.

scenes.narration: सोहम को यह आवाज़ अच्छी लगी। टन टन, दो घंटी, रास्ता खाली!
scenes.caption: Sohum liked this sound better than before. Ting ting, two bells, road clear!
scenes.image_brief: Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, stands astride the small bicycle outside the shop smiling with his head turned back to his four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails, who is ringing the brass bell with both hands. Warm morning light down the narrow lane, contented mood.

title: 😮 क्या सरगम बारिश में धुले चौकों के बाद नौ तक पहुँच पाएगी? #hindikids #khel
title_alts: 🤔 सरगम ने कंकड़ फेंका और एक पैर पर कूदी, तभी बड़ी बूँदें गिरीं... #hindikids #khel
😅 सरगम के नौ चौके और ख़त्म हुआ चाक... आँगन में गिनती अब कैसे चले? #hindikids #khel
refrain: एक चौका, दो चौका, नौ तक!
description_hook: सरगम का कंकड़ नौवें चौके तक जाना था। बारिश की पहली बूँदों ने आख़िरी तीन चौके धो दिए।

characters.name: सरगम
characters.description: six years old, high ponytail in a green band, white school shirt and red skirt, one chalky palm

scenes.narration: नौवें चौके तक सरगम को पहुँचना था, बारिश आ रही थी। आँगन में नौ चौके।
scenes.caption: Sargam had to reach the ninth square before the rain. Nine chalk squares waited.
scenes.image_brief: Sargam, a six-year-old girl with a high ponytail tied in a green band, a white school shirt and a red skirt, stands at the start of a line of nine chalk squares drawn across a stone courtyard, a flat pebble in her raised hand. The first six squares lie in the strip shaded by a verandah roof, the last three out in the open. Grey clouds gathering above, the light going dim, hurried mood.

scenes.narration: सरगम ने कंकड़ फेंका, चौके में गिरा। एक पैर पर कूदी। तुम भी ताली दो!
scenes.caption: Sargam threw her pebble into a square and hopped on one foot. Clap along too!
scenes.image_brief: Sargam, a six-year-old girl with a high ponytail tied in a green band, a white school shirt and a red skirt, balances on one foot inside a chalk square in the stone courtyard, her other foot lifted behind her, the flat pebble resting in the square ahead of her. Chalk numbers visible in the squares. Dim pre-rain light, first dark spots on the stone.

scenes.narration: एक चौका, दो चौका, नौ तक!
scenes.caption: One square, two squares, all the way to nine!
scenes.image_brief: Sargam, a six-year-old girl with a high ponytail tied in a green band, a white school shirt and a red skirt, hops with both arms out and her mouth open in a chant along the chalk squares in the stone courtyard. The line of squares stretches ahead of her into the open part of the yard. Dim grey light before rain.

scenes.narration: बड़ी बूँदें गिरीं। सात, आठ, नौ के चौके धुल गए। चाक ख़त्म था।
scenes.caption: Big drops fell. Squares seven, eight and nine washed away. The chalk was finished.
scenes.image_brief: Sargam, a six-year-old girl with a high ponytail tied in a green band, a white school shirt and a red skirt, stands at the edge of the verandah shade in the stone courtyard looking at the last three chalk squares, which have blurred into pale smears under falling rain. A worn chalk stub lies snapped in her open palm. Wet grey light, rain streaking the open yard.

scenes.narration: सरगम ने बरगद के तीन पत्ते उठाए। बरामदे में तीन चौके बनाए। बोली, “एक चौका, दो चौका, नौ तक!”
scenes.caption: Sargam picked three banyan leaves and laid three squares under the verandah roof.
scenes.image_brief: Sargam, a six-year-old girl with a high ponytail tied in a green band, a white school shirt and a red skirt, kneels under the dry verandah roof placing three big banyan leaves in a row on the stone so that they continue the six chalk squares, her mouth open in a chant. Rain falls just beyond the roof edge. Soft grey light, busy and pleased mood.

scenes.narration: एक चौका, दो चौका, नौ तक!
scenes.caption: One square, two squares, all the way to nine!
scenes.image_brief: Sargam, a six-year-old girl with a high ponytail tied in a green band, a white school shirt and a red skirt, hops from the last chalk square onto the first banyan leaf under the verandah roof, arms out and mouth open in a chant. Rain curtains the open courtyard behind her. Soft grey light, bright mood.

scenes.narration: पत्तों पर कूदने की आवाज़ धीमी थी। धीरे से गिनो, तुम भी।
scenes.caption: Hopping on the leaves made a softer sound. Count along, softly.
scenes.image_brief: Sargam, a six-year-old girl with a high ponytail tied in a green band, a white school shirt and a red skirt, hops slowly from one banyan leaf to the next under the verandah roof, her ponytail swinging, the wet courtyard shining beyond. A cat watches from a dry step. Calm grey light, quiet mood.

scenes.narration: सरगम नौवें पत्ते पर रुकी, खेल पूरा लगा। एक चौका, दो चौका, नौ तक!
scenes.caption: Sargam stopped on the ninth leaf; the game felt finished. One square, two, to nine!
scenes.image_brief: Sargam, a six-year-old girl with a high ponytail tied in a green band, a white school shirt and a red skirt, stands with both feet together on the third banyan leaf at the end of the row under the verandah roof, smiling, the pebble in her fist. Rain drips from the roof edge behind her. Soft grey light, satisfied mood.

title: 💛 आरव ने दादी की गोद में किताब रखी, पर अक्षर बहुत छोटे थे... #kids #dadi
title_alts: 🤔 क्या आरव की दादी छोटे अक्षरों वाली कविता में अपनी बारी गा पाएँगी? #kids #dadi
😊 आरव की कविता और दादी की ख़ाली बारी... अगली लाइन कौन गाए? #kids #dadi
refrain: एक लाइन दादी, एक लाइन मैं!
description_hook: आरव को कविता दादी के साथ बारी बारी गानी थी। किताब के अक्षर दादी के लिए बहुत छोटे थे।

characters.name: आरव
characters.description: six years old, side-parted fringe, red t-shirt and khaki shorts, a pencil behind one ear

scenes.narration: बरामदे में आरव को दादी के साथ कविता गानी थी। अक्षर बहुत छोटे थे।
scenes.caption: Aarav wanted to sing the poem with Daadi. The letters were far too small.
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a six-year-old boy with a side-parted fringe, a red t-shirt and khaki shorts, sits on a cane stool on a verandah beside his grandmother Daadi, in a pale green cotton saree with silver-white hair in a small bun and thick glasses, who sits in a wooden chair holding a thin poem book open on her knees. Six children sing in the courtyard beyond the verandah steps. Bright late morning light, a hanging washing line across the verandah, tender mood.

scenes.narration: आरव ने किताब दादी की गोद में रखी। गाया, “एक लाइन दादी, एक लाइन मैं!”
scenes.caption: Aarav laid the book in Daadi's lap and sang: one line Daadi, one line me!
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a six-year-old boy with a side-parted fringe, a red t-shirt and khaki shorts, places the open poem book in the lap of his grandmother Daadi, in a pale green cotton saree with silver-white hair in a small bun and thick glasses on the verandah and sings with his chin lifted, one hand on the page. Daadi leans close to the small print with her glasses pushed up. Bright morning light, the courtyard visible past the steps.

scenes.narration: एक लाइन दादी, एक लाइन मैं!
scenes.caption: One line for Daadi, one line for me!
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a six-year-old boy with a side-parted fringe, a red t-shirt and khaki shorts, stands on the verandah beside his grandmother Daadi, in a pale green cotton saree with silver-white hair in a small bun and thick glasses in her chair, pointing at himself and then at her as he chants, the poem book open on her knees. Bright morning light across the verandah floor.

scenes.narration: बाहर बच्चों का गाना अगले पद पर पहुँच गया। दादी की बारी ख़ाली रही। तुम भी ताली दो!
scenes.caption: Outside the children reached the next verse. Daadi's turn stayed empty. Clap along too!
scenes.image_brief: Six children in the courtyard clap and sing together, already further on in the poem, while on the verandah his grandmother Daadi, in a pale green cotton saree with silver-white hair in a small bun and thick glasses sits silent with the book closed on her knees and Aarav, a six-year-old boy with a side-parted fringe, a red t-shirt and khaki shorts, stands beside her chair with his hands at his sides. Bright hard midday light, flat and quiet on the verandah.

scenes.narration: आरव ने हर लाइन का एक मोटा चित्र बनाया। डोरी पर चिमटियों से टाँग दिए।
scenes.caption: Aarav drew one big picture for every line and pegged them on the washing line.
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a six-year-old boy with a side-parted fringe, a red t-shirt and khaki shorts, clips large simple crayon drawings, one per line of the poem, onto the washing line stretched across the verandah using wooden clothes pegs. his grandmother Daadi, in a pale green cotton saree with silver-white hair in a small bun and thick glasses watches from her chair. Bright afternoon light, paper squares swaying, busy mood.

scenes.narration: एक लाइन दादी, एक लाइन मैं!
scenes.caption: One line for Daadi, one line for me!
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a six-year-old boy with a side-parted fringe, a red t-shirt and khaki shorts, stands under the row of pegged crayon drawings on the verandah washing line with one hand raised to the first sheet, chanting, while his grandmother Daadi, in a pale green cotton saree with silver-white hair in a small bun and thick glasses looks up at the pictures from her chair. Warm afternoon light.

scenes.narration: दादी ने पहला चित्र पकड़ा, गाने लगीं। तुम भी गाओ।
scenes.caption: Daadi held the first picture and began to sing. Sing along too.
scenes.image_brief: His grandmother daadi, in a pale green cotton saree with silver-white hair in a small bun and thick glasses holds the first pegged crayon drawing between two fingers on the verandah and sings with her head tilted back, while Aarav, a six-year-old boy with a side-parted fringe, a red t-shirt and khaki shorts, stands beside her with both hands on the washing line. Warm afternoon light, gentle mood.

scenes.narration: आरव को दादी की आवाज़ नई लगी। एक लाइन दादी, एक लाइन मैं!
scenes.caption: Daadi's voice sounded new to Aarav. One line for Daadi, one line for me!
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a six-year-old boy with a side-parted fringe, a red t-shirt and khaki shorts, sits on the verandah floor leaning against the chair of his grandmother Daadi, in a pale green cotton saree with silver-white hair in a small bun and thick glasses, both of them singing, the row of crayon drawings swaying on the washing line above them. Six children listen from the courtyard steps. Warm low afternoon light, contented mood.

title: 🌧️ रोहन भीगे रास्ते पर दौड़ा... क्या छप-छप होगी? #rhyme
title_alts: 🌧️ रोहन के नन्हे नीले बूट... पानी कहाँ उछला? #rhyme
🌧️ रोहन ने कीचड़ में छलांग लगाई... क्या नाली बहेगी? #rhyme
refrain: कीचड़ में छप-छप, नन्हे नीले बूट।
description_hook: रोहन को सुबह की बारिश में भीगे रास्ते पर नीले बूट पहनकर छप-छप करनी थी।

characters.name: रोहन
characters.description: five-year-old boy, curly black hair, yellow raincoat, blue boots

scenes.narration: रोहन आज सुबह बगीचे के भीगे रास्ते पर दौड़ा।
scenes.caption: Rohan ran across the wet garden path in the rain today.
scenes.image_brief: Rohan, a five-year-old boy with curly black hair, yellow raincoat, and blue boots, standing on a wet gravel garden path under gentle grey rain showers

scenes.narration: रोहन के साथ कूदो: उछलो, कूदो, तेज़ भागो। आसमान से गिरीं बारिश की ठंडी बूंदें, रोहन ने अपनी दोनों आंखें मूंदीं। कीचड़ का पानी ऊपर उछलने लगा, हर तरफ़ पानी का घेरा चमकने लगा।
scenes.caption: Jump with Rohan: cold drops fall, and muddy water splashes high.
scenes.image_brief: Rohan leaping with both feet into a shallow brown puddle as muddy water sprays upward around his boots

scenes.narration: कीचड़ में छप-छप, नन्हे नीले बूट।
scenes.caption: Splash in the mud, tap little blue boots.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of bright blue boots splashing firmly into dark garden mud with ripples spreading outward

scenes.narration: रोहन के साथ बजाओ: ताल, ताल, छप। रोहन ने उठाई लकड़ी की पतली छड़ी, पानी की नाली उसने ज़मीन पर गढ़ी। बहने लगा पानी हरी घास की ओर, शांत हुआ आंगन का सारा शोर।
scenes.caption: Rohan carved a small trench with a stick to guide puddle water to the grass.
scenes.image_brief: Rohan kneeling on the path using a sturdy wooden stick to channel water toward green lawn grass

scenes.narration: कीचड़ में छप-छप, नन्हे नीले बूट।
scenes.caption: Splash in the mud, tap little blue boots.
scenes.image_brief: Blue rainboots stamping rhythmically in the shallow muddy trail under gentle rainfall

scenes.narration: रोहन के कदम धीरे-धीरे रुक गए, बादल के टुकड़े आसमान में झुक गए। सूरज की सुनहरी किरणें खिल उठीं, चेहरे पर मीठी मुस्कान मिल उठी।
scenes.caption: Rohan slowed down as clouds parted and golden sunlight broke through.
scenes.image_brief: Rohan walking slowly along the wet garden stones as warm sunlight bathes the garden

scenes.narration: कीचड़ में छप-छप, नन्हे नीले बूट।
scenes.caption: Splash in the mud, tap little blue boots.
scenes.image_brief: The bright blue boots resting neatly on a dry stone doorstep beside a closed umbrella

title: ⛵ मीरा ने कागज़ की नाव तैराई... क्या वह आगे बढ़ेगी? #rhyme
title_alts: ⛵ मीरा की नन्ही नाव हिली... क्या पानी तैराएगा? #rhyme
⛵ मीरा ने फूंक मारी... नाव कहाँ तक जाएगी? #rhyme
refrain: तैराओ कागज़ की नाव, पानी पर बहाओ।
description_hook: मीरा को आंगन के कुंड में अपनी सफ़ेद कागज़ की नाव धीरे-धीरे तैराकर पार ले जानी थी।

characters.name: मीरा
characters.description: six-year-old girl, sleek braids, red frock, white sandals

scenes.narration: मीरा आज दोपहर आंगन के कुंड के पास आई।
scenes.caption: Meera walked to the courtyard stone water basin at noon today.
scenes.image_brief: Meera, a six-year-old girl with sleek braids, red frock, and white sandals, kneeling beside a clear stone water basin holding a folded paper boat

scenes.narration: मीरा के साथ तैराओ: बढ़ो, बढ़ो, चलो नाव। कागज़ की सुंदर नाव बनाई, पानी की लहरों पर धीरे चलाई। हवा ने हल्का सा झटका दिया, पानी ने नाव को तिरछा किया।
scenes.caption: Float with Meera: the crisp paper boat rocked gently on the water ripples.
scenes.image_brief: Meera gently placing her white folded paper boat onto shimmering clear water in the stone basin

scenes.narration: तैराओ कागज़ की नाव, पानी पर बहाओ।
scenes.caption: Float the paper boat, sail it on the water.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of the white paper boat floating gracefully on clear water ripples over grey stones

scenes.narration: मीरा के साथ फूंक मारो: फूंक, फूंक, बहो। मीरा ने धीरे से फूंक लगाई, कागज़ की नन्ही नाव आगे बढ़ाई। पत्थरों से बचकर नाव निकल गई, लहरों के संग दूर तक बह गई।
scenes.caption: Meera blew gently to steer the little boat past the stones.
scenes.image_brief: Meera leaning close to the water surface, blowing softly into the triangular paper sail

scenes.narration: तैराओ कागज़ की नाव, पानी पर बहाओ।
scenes.caption: Float the paper boat, sail it on the water.
scenes.image_brief: The paper boat skimming smoothly across the calm water basin in bright afternoon sunshine

scenes.narration: मीरा ने नाव को देखकर हंसा, शाम की धूप में पानी चमका। शांत हुआ पानी और दिन ढल गया, मन में खुशी का दीप जल गया।
scenes.caption: Meera smiled watching the boat sail as evening light bathed the courtyard.
scenes.image_brief: Meera sitting back on her heels with a proud, happy smile as the boat floats in soft sunlight

scenes.narration: तैराओ कागज़ की नाव, पानी पर बहाओ।
scenes.caption: Float the paper boat, sail it on the water.
scenes.image_brief: The paper boat resting peacefully in clear water beside smooth green moss on the basin rim

title: 🌀 कबीर ने रंगीन फिरकी घुमाई... क्या हवा में नाचेगी? #rhyme
title_alts: 🌀 कबीर की फिरकी तेज़ घूमी... क्या रंग चमकेंगे? #rhyme
🌀 कबीर पहाड़ी पर दौड़ा... फिरकी कैसे उड़ेगी? #rhyme
refrain: घूमो रंगीन फिरकी, तेज़ हवा में घूमो।
description_hook: कबीर को धूप खिली पहाड़ी पर अपनी रंगीन कागज़ की फिरकी हवा में तेज़ घुमानी थी।

characters.name: कबीर
characters.description: four-year-old boy, curly black hair, yellow tee, green shorts

scenes.narration: कबीर आज धूप खिली पहाड़ी पर फिरकी लेकर दौड़ा।
scenes.caption: Kabir ran across the sunny park hill with his pinwheel today.
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, a four-year-old boy with curly black hair, yellow tee, and green shorts, sprinting up a grassy hill holding a bright rainbow pinwheel

scenes.narration: कबीर के साथ घूमो: घूमो, घूमो, तेज़ घूमो। लाल और पीली फिरकी हाथ में थामी, हवा ने आकर सुंदर बात मानी। नन्हे पंख हवा में फड़फड़ाने लगे, गोल-गोल पहिए तेज़ी से घूमने लगे।
scenes.caption: Spin with Kabir: bright wings whirred rapidly in the fresh hilltop breeze.
scenes.image_brief: The rainbow paper pinwheel spinning rapidly into a colorful blur against a clear blue sky

scenes.narration: घूमो रंगीन फिरकी, तेज़ हवा में घूमो।
scenes.caption: Spin the colorful pinwheel, turn fast in the breeze.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of the vibrant folded paper pinwheel whirling smoothly on its wooden dowel

scenes.narration: कबीर के साथ दौड़ो: भागो, भागो, तेज़ भागो। कबीर ने मैदान में ज़ोर से कदम बढ़ाए, फिरकी के सारे रंग हवा में लहराए। पंखों की सरसराहट मीठी लगने लगी, आंगन में खुशियों की धुन जगने लगी।
scenes.caption: Kabir ran with big strides, making the pinwheel hum with sweet sounds.
scenes.image_brief: Kabir running joyfully across the open lawn, laughing as the pinwheel spins beside his head

scenes.narration: घूमो रंगीन फिरकी, तेज़ हवा में घूमो।
scenes.caption: Spin the colorful pinwheel, turn fast in the breeze.
scenes.image_brief: The pinwheel casting dancing colorful shadows onto the green hillside grass in the sun

scenes.narration: कबीर पहाड़ी पर बैठकर मुस्कुराया, शाम की ठंडी छांव ने मन हर्षाया। धीमी हुई हवा और दिन ढलने लगा, आसमान में सुनहरा रंग मिलने लगा।
scenes.caption: Kabir sat on the crest smiling contentedly as the wind softened at sunset.
scenes.image_brief: Kabir sitting comfortably on the grass crest with the pinwheel planted beside him in golden light

scenes.narration: घूमो रंगीन फिरकी, तेज़ हवा में घूमो।
scenes.caption: Spin the colorful pinwheel, turn fast in the breeze.
scenes.image_brief: The rainbow paper pinwheel resting upright in the lawn, turning gently in the calm dusk air

title: 🐦 तारा ने नन्ही चिड़िया को दाना दिया... क्या वह आएगी? #rhyme
title_alts: 🐦 तारा ने मिट्टी का सकोरा रखा... क्या गौरैया चहकेगी? #rhyme
🐦 तारा ने सुनहरे दाने बिखेरे... कौन उड़कर आया? #rhyme
refrain: डालो सुनहरे दाने, नन्ही चिड़िया आओ।
description_hook: तारा को सुबह बरामदे के चबूतरे पर बाजरे के सुनहरे दाने डालकर चिड़िया को बुलाना था।

characters.name: तारा
characters.description: five-year-old girl, curly dark hair, orange frock, white sandals

scenes.narration: तारा आज सुबह बरामदे के चबूतरे पर दाना लेकर आई।
scenes.caption: Tara brought birdseed to the veranda ledge early this morning.
scenes.image_brief: Tara, a five-year-old girl with curly dark hair, orange frock, and white sandals, carrying a small clay cup filled with golden millet

scenes.narration: तारा के साथ डालो: बिखेरो, डालो, दाना रखो। मिट्टी की कटोरी में बाजरे के दाने, तारा बैठी नन्ही चिड़ियों को बुलाने। भूखी गौरैया दूर डाल पर बैठी थी, पंख सिकोड़े चुपचाप देख रही थी।
scenes.caption: Scatter with Tara: hungry sparrows watched from the quiet tree branch.
scenes.image_brief: Tara spreading golden millet across a wooden feeding board while a sparrow watches from above

scenes.narration: डालो सुनहरे दाने, नन्ही चिड़िया आओ।
scenes.caption: Drop the golden seeds, come little sparrow.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of golden millet grains scattered across the clean cedar feeder tray

scenes.narration: तारा के साथ पुकारो: आओ, आओ, पास आओ। तारा ने धीरे से दाने बिखेरे, आंगन में लौटे सुबह के सवेरे। फुदक-फुदक कर चिड़िया नीचे उतर आई, चोंच में दाना भरकर खुशी मनाई।
scenes.caption: The sparrow hopped down gently and began pecking the seeds happily.
scenes.image_brief: A small brown sparrow hopping onto the feeder board, pecking seeds near Tara's quiet hands

scenes.narration: डालो सुनहरे दाने, नन्ही चिड़िया आओ।
scenes.caption: Drop the golden seeds, come little sparrow.
scenes.image_brief: Two sparrows chirping contentedly with millet grains held in their tiny beaks

scenes.narration: तारा ने चिड़िया को देखकर मुस्कुराया, मीठे चहकने से सारा घर महकाया। धूप की किरणें पेड़ों से छनने लगीं, मन में सुकून की बातें बनने लगीं।
scenes.caption: Tara smiled affectionately as chirping songs filled the sunny veranda.
scenes.image_brief: Tara resting her chin on her hands, smiling warmly as sparrows flutter and feed in morning light

scenes.narration: डालो सुनहरे दाने, नन्ही चिड़िया आओ।
scenes.caption: Drop the golden seeds, come little sparrow.
scenes.image_brief: The cedar bird tray resting peacefully on the railing in warm morning sunshine as birds feed
